groups.title: Text
groups.summary: Markup, rules and pixel lettering. Text is measured in terminal cells, so emoji and CJK keep the grid.

groups.title: Layout
groups.summary: Containers that place other widgets. Any widget can sit inside any container, including a live dashboard.

groups.title: Status and progress
groups.summary: The widgets a live session updates: facts, steps, trees, bars, phases, spinners and the log region.

groups.title: Charts
groups.summary: Bars, stacked bars, sparklines, histograms and braille line and scatter charts, all scaled to their cells.

examples.title: Progress
examples.summary: Labelled bars with a percentage and a count, in line or block shape.
examples.csharp:
Terminal.Write(new Rows()
    .Add(new ProgressBar("Build") { Value = 64, Total = 100 })
    .Add(new ProgressBar("Tests") { Value = 412, Total = 530 })
    .Add(new ProgressBar("Docs") { Value = 100, Total = 100, Status = StatusKind.Pass })
    .Add(new ProgressBar("Upload") { Value = 3, Total = 8, Shape = BarShape.Block }));
examples.powershellFull:
Import-Module ConsoleMonster

New-ConsoleRows -Content {
    New-ConsoleProgress -Label 'Build' -Value 64 -Total 100
    New-ConsoleProgress -Label 'Tests' -Value 412 -Total 530
    New-ConsoleProgress -Label 'Docs' -Value 100 -Total 100 -Status Pass
    New-ConsoleProgress -Label 'Upload' -Value 3 -Total 8 -Shape Block
} | Show-Console
